subject: maths
question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 62,500 for 2 years at 12% p.a., if the interest is compounded 8-monthly?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 62500

Time = 2 years

Rate = 12%

**Concept used:**

C.I = P[(1 + R/100)T - 1]

Here,

P = Sum

T = Time

R = Rate

When interest is being calculated at 8 monthly,

Rate = (R/12) × 8

Time = T × (3/2)

**Calculation:**

12% interest for 12 months

So, 8% interest for 8 months

Time = 2 × (3/2)

⇒ 3

C.I = 62500[(1 + 8/100)³ - 1]

⇒ C.I = 62500[(27/25)³ - 1]

⇒ C.I = 62500[(19683/15625) - 1]

⇒ C.I = 62500[(19683 - 15625)/15625]

⇒ C.I = 62500[(4058)/15625]

⇒ C.I = 16232

**∴ The required interest is Rs.16232.**
